title: Review: SSE/watch/fixes batch (8a361ab)
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — The primary risk is the kithctl watch notification pipeline (wrong field name, stale cursor on error). Both are user-visible on first use. The schema migrations (V18/V19) carry a one-time classification hazard for upgrading users but self-heals. The rest of the changes are solid.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) kith-peer diff was large and I did not get to read all of the ReceiptHandler changes in detail; (2) the outbox complete_delivery_in_tx rewrite is subtle and the SELECT+UPDATE ordering has concurrency implications I may not have fully traced; (3) the equal-counter replay semantics interact with client state in ways that are hard to reason about without an end-to-end test that reconnects mid-stream. Would raise confidence if: end-to-end integration test covering reconnect-with-LEI and message delivery notification with correct sender display.
